# NowAnime

> NowAnime is a free, ad-supported anime streaming and download app. Watch subbed and dubbed anime in HD, download episodes for offline viewing, no signup required.

NowAnime aggregates anime metadata from AniList, Jikan and TMDB and streams via community-hosted embed providers (111Movies HD + SmashyStream fallback). The app is mobile-first, installable as a PWA, and available as a free Android APK. Everything is free — supported by non-intrusive ads.

## What it is

- **Free forever** — no subscription, no paywall, no signup.
- **Anime only** — trending, seasonal, top-rated, classic subbed & dubbed anime series and movies.
- **HD streaming** — 111Movies as the primary HD source, SmashyStream as automatic fallback.
- **Offline downloads** — save episodes for offline playback through the built-in downloader.
- **PWA + Android APK** — installable on any phone, tablet or desktop.

## Featured pages

- [Home](https://nowanime.lovable.app/): Fan favorites, trending anime, new releases and personalized rows.
- [Anime](https://nowanime.lovable.app/anime): Full anime catalog with genre filters and seasonal picks.
- [Search](https://nowanime.lovable.app/search): Search subbed & dubbed anime titles.
- [My Downloads](https://nowanime.lovable.app/my-downloads): Manage saved episodes for offline playback.
- [Install App](https://nowanime.lovable.app/install): Free Android APK with install guide.
- [Settings](https://nowanime.lovable.app/settings): Playback quality, subtitles, download and privacy preferences.
- [Profile](https://nowanime.lovable.app/profile): Watch history, my list and stats.
